label: For "Synthetic Identity Fraud Detection": Catch fabricated identities built from real and fake attributes at application time, before they bust out on credit lines. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Cluster members split across train and test leak the ring.
